netherview.config.title: NetherView Settings
netherview.config.maxLivePortals.tooltip: Portals that show the other side live each frame (nearest first). Each one is an extra world render; the rest show a flat card.
netherview.config.liveViewDistance.toolt: Portals farther away than this only show a flat card.
netherview.config.remoteRenderDistance.t: How far you see through a portal. Never more than your own render distance.
netherview.config.maxPortalSize.tooltip: Portals wider or taller than this stay normal portals.
netherview.config.portalParticles.toolti: Share of the swirl particles a see-through portal keeps.
How strongly the portal's swirl or starfield shows over a live view. 0% is a clear window.
netherview.config.offlinePreviews.toolti: On servers without NetherView: portals you've been through show the far side as you last saw it, and the trip skips the loading screen.
netherview.config.offlinePortalOpacity.t: How strongly the portal's swirl or starfield shows over an offline preview. 0% is a clear window.
netherview.config.offlineCacheMb.tooltip: Disk space for remembered chunks, per server. The least recently used go first.
